title: 第5章 若太上来先打一顿第6章 人皇帝辛大德所归
slug: 重生商纣开局怒怼圣人女娲
content_zh:
第5章若太上来，先打一顿！“女娲道友，老师喊我们去紫霄……”
心慌的太上刚要劝阻女娲离开，忽然看到商容颤颤巍巍地站了起来，凑到帝辛的耳边，
低声道：“大王，女娲娘娘和太上圣人齐齐显圣，我看要不大王给娘娘道个歉，毕竟圣人一怒，天翻地覆啊！”
哪知道帝辛听后虎目圆瞪，剑指女娲大声道：“道歉？孤王说得有错吗？就算是要道歉，也得是她女娲给孤王道歉！”
看到帝辛的样子，女娲简直要气炸了。
正准备拼着被天道反噬，也要教训帝辛的时候，太上忽然伸手拦住了她。
看着帝辛，冷冷地质问道：“帝辛，你虽为人皇，但也不能对圣人不敬，你题诗亵渎女娲道友，道友前来质问，还是道友的不对了！”
听到太上的话，帝辛嘴角微扬，露出了老狐狸般的笑容。
正想该怎么怼你呢，没想到你自己送上门来了！
想到这，帝辛冷冷地看了一眼太上：“孤王本来不想搭理你，既然你说了，今天孤王就跟你算算我们之间的账！”
“你身为人教教主，空占人族气运，为人族做过什么？一句‘无为而治’就将亿万万人族打发了？真是应了那句老话——圣人不死，大盗不止！”
“还有，你说孤王题诗亵渎女娲，这难道不是你们的算计，孤王身为人皇，坐拥天下美女，岂会被一个泥塑吸引到失去理智？”
“女娲，孤王问你，当初孤王进入娲皇庙之后，你可知后面发生的事？太上，孤王也问你，你可曾寻找过孤王题诗的真相？”
呃……
帝辛一句话怼的两人哑口无言！
真相是什么，实际上对他们来说并不重要！
他们要的是一个‘人皇无德’引子，用来推动封神大劫，用来瓜分人道和地道气运功德，提升自己的实力！
所以，这可笑的真相重要吗？
并不是他们不想寻找，而是没有必要！
想到这里，太上缓缓摇头，叹息道：“帝辛，任你巧舌如簧，你亵渎人族圣母的事情已成事实，人皇无德，本圣自会前去火云洞面见三皇，为人族另立明主！”

轰！
听到太上的话后，朝歌内的所有人，俱都感觉脑海中仿佛有什么爆炸了一样，大脑瞬间陷入一片空白中！
噗通！
一旁勉强站起来的商容和文阁七王等人，再度跪在城墙上，近乎哀求道：“求太上绕过大王，大王当时只是一时糊涂，恳请圣人大人大量！”
“求太上绕过大王，大王当时只是一时糊涂，恳请圣人大人大量！”
……
一时间，
朝歌中传出了震耳欲聋的声音！
因为真正的帝辛并不昏庸，甚至还做出了许多利民的事情，十分得朝歌众人的拥护！
“尔等不必求情，人皇无德，本圣和三皇自有打算！”
但，
面对众人的哀求，太上却始终不曾松口，铁了心地要去火云洞。
就连一旁的女娲也跟着点了点头！
“哈哈哈……”
可就在这时，一道震耳欲聋的狂笑声，忽然在所有人耳边响起，一瞬间，所有人的目光，全都落在狂笑的帝辛身上！
女娲见状冷冷道：“帝辛，你还敢笑？”
“哈哈……孤王为何不敢笑，去火云洞？要不要孤王陪你们一起？”
哪知道帝辛不但不怂，反倒是露出一副狂上天的样子，看向太上和女娲的眼神，更是充满了嘲讽和不屑。
“太上，你身为人教教主，孤王问你，若天庭算计人族，你当如何？”
content_en:
Chapter 5 If Tai comes up, give him a beating first! "Fellow Taoist Nuwa, the teacher called us to go to Zixiao..."
The flustered Emperor was just about to dissuade Nuwa from leaving when he suddenly saw Shang Rong standing up tremblingly and leaning towards Di Xin's ear.
He said in a low voice: "Your Majesty, Empress Nuwa and the Supreme Saint are all showing their sage together. I think it would be better for your Majesty to apologize to the empress. After all, when the saint is angry, the world will be turned upside down!"
Unexpectedly, Di Xin's eyes widened after hearing this, and he pointed his sword at Nuwa and shouted loudly: "Apologise? Is the lonely king wrong? Even if he wants to apologize, she, Nuwa, must apologize to the lonely king!"
Seeing Di Xin's appearance, Nuwa was almost furious.
Just when she was about to try her best to teach Di Xin a lesson because of the backlash from Heaven, the Supreme Being suddenly reached out to stop her.
Looking at Di Xin, he asked coldly: "Di Xin, although you are the emperor, you can't disrespect the saint. You wrote a poem to blaspheme Taoist Nuwa, and Taoist Taoist came to question you. It's Taoist Taoist's fault!"
Hearing the words of the Supreme Being, Di Xin raised the corners of his mouth slightly, revealing a smile like an old fox.
I was just thinking about how to retaliate against you, but I didn’t expect you to come to my door yourself!
Thinking of this, Di Xin glanced at the Supreme Being coldly: "The Solitary King originally didn't want to talk to you, but since you said so, the Solitary King will settle the score between us with you today!"
"As the leader of the Human Religion, what have you done for the human race by taking advantage of the fate of the human race? You dismissed hundreds of millions of human race with just 'ruling by doing nothing'? It really is in compliance with the old saying - until the saint dies, there will be no more robbers!"
"Also, you said that the lonely king wrote a poem to blaspheme Nuwa. Isn't this your plan? As a human emperor, with all the beauties in the world, how could he lose his mind by being attracted by a clay sculpture?"
"Nuwa, the solitary king asks you, did you know what happened after the solitary king entered the Wahuang Temple? Your Majesty, the solitary king also asks you, have you ever found the truth about the solitary king's poem?"
Uh...
Di Xin's retort left the two of them speechless!
It doesn't actually matter to them what the truth is!
What they want is a "human emperor has no virtue" introduction to promote the great catastrophe of becoming a god, to divide the merits of human and authentic luck, and to enhance their own strength!
So, does this ridiculous truth matter?
It’s not that they don’t want to search, it’s just that there’s no need!
Thinking of this, the Supreme Leader slowly shook his head and sighed: "Emperor Xin, no matter how clever you are, your blasphemy against the Holy Mother of the Human Race has become a fact. The Human Emperor has no virtue. I will go to the Fire Cloud Cave to meet the Three Emperors and establish a new emperor for the Human Race!"
Boom!
After hearing the words of the Supreme Leader, everyone in Chaoge felt as if something exploded in their minds, and their brains instantly fell into a blank!
Plop!
Shang Rong, the Seven Kings of Wen Pavilion and others who stood up reluctantly on the side knelt on the city wall again and almost begged: "Please, Your Majesty, bypass the king. The king was just confused at the time. I beg the saint to give you more!"
"Please, Your Majesty, bypass the king. The king was just confused at that time. I beg the saint to give you more!"
…
for a time,
A deafening sound came from the song!
Because the real Emperor Xin was not mediocre, he even did many things that benefited the people, and he was highly supported by everyone in Chaoge!
"You don't need to plead for mercy. The Human Emperor has no virtue. This Saint and the Three Emperors have their own plans!"
But,
In the face of everyone's pleading, the Supreme Being never relented and was determined to go to Huoyun Cave.
Even Nuwa on the side nodded!
"Hahaha..."
But at this moment, a deafening roar of laughter suddenly sounded in everyone's ears. In an instant, everyone's eyes fell on the laughing Di Xin!
Nuwa saw this and said coldly: "Di Xin, do you still dare to laugh?"
"Haha... Why doesn't King Gu dare to laugh and go to Fire Cloud Cave? Do you want King Gu to accompany you?"
Unexpectedly, Di Xin not only did not give up, but also showed a look of madness. His eyes looking at the Supreme Being and Nuwa were full of ridicule and disdain.
"Your Majesty, as a human being, you teach meLord, the lonely king asks you, if heaven plots against the human race, what should you do? "
